notes:
Gets v2.48's fixes to chapters you've already read.

Pages remember what they say, so three of the fixes only reached chapters you hadn't opened yet. Those pages are read again once, and then:

• balloons are spoken as whole sentences rather than in fragments
• the studio credit at the end of a chapter is gone
• bleeped swearing is spoken as the word

Chapters you've already prepared will take a moment to re-read the first time you open them.

Also in 2.48: no more title card read at the start of every chapter, and lines stop being clipped before their last word.
